svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.13.8 Required Weep Holes
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Weep holes at the bottom of the cavity
At the bottom of the wall
Weep holes above a lintel over an
Above a lintel over an opening

svg.text: Weep holes spaced not more than 800 mm (31½″)
apart are provided at the bottom of
(a) cavities in cavity walls, and (b) cavities or
air spaces in masonry veneer walls.
These cavities or air spaces include those
above lintels over window and door openings
required to be flashed in conformance with
Drawn: outer wythe of the wall seen from outside, backing not shown, weep holes as open head joints, flashing lip exaggerated. Spacing measured between weep holes.
